title: Section presheaf of a constant sheaf pushed forward from a closed subset
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $C\subseteq X$ a subset and $R$ a set. Define the presheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] $L_{C,R}$ by $L_{C,R}(V)=\{\text{locally constant maps }V\cap C\to R\}$ for every open $V\subseteq X$, with the subspace topology on $V\cap C$ and restriction of functions as transition maps. When $C$ is closed this is the section presheaf of the direct image of the constant sheaf on $C$.
